models.when: direct questions and explanations, quick lookups, small single-file edits, routine fixes and tweaks with clear scope
committing changes and writing the commit message — including /commit or any commit command — plus other short one-shot generation with a fixed format
implementing features that span several files, debugging a failure or unexpected behavior, refactoring, reviewing changes for correctness and design
architecture design or redesign, cross-cutting changes touching many modules, hard debugging where the cause resists obvious fixes, deep analysis of a large codebase or long history
